docRequirement: interactive-mode.md:357-387 binds a built-in `/btw` command: "Use `/btw` to ask a quick question about your current work without adding to the conversation history." (:359). The answer channel is specified, not suggested — side questions have "full visibility into the current conversation" (:365), "The question and answer are ephemeral: they appear in a dismissible overlay and never enter the conversation history" (:365), they are **Available while Claude is working** (:367), have **No tool access** (:368, "Claude can't read files, run commands, or search"), are a **Single response** forkable into its own session with `f` (:369, :384), reuse the parent prompt cache (:370), keep earlier exchanges as a dimmed list until cleared (:372), reopen on `/btw` with no question (:374), and accept `Space`/`Enter`/`Escape`, `Up`/`Down`, `Left`/`Right`, `c`, `f`, `x` (:378-385). The same page also binds `/recap` — "Run `/recap` to generate a summary on demand" with automatic recaps toggled by `/config` -> **Session recap** (:402), on by default and "always skipped in non-interactive mode" (:404) — plus emoji shortcodes with `emojiCompletionEnabled` (:346-355), `respondToBashCommands` defaulting to a model response on `!` output (:321), and `editorMode`/`vimInsertModeRemaps` (:140, :146-147).
current: There is no `/btw` and no `/recap` anywhere. The built-in command set is one union of 16 ids — `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/ui/slash-command-menu.tsx:17` — and it lists neither; the menu items derive from `featureCommands` (same file :225) and `DEFAULT_SLASH_COMMANDS` (:242), with the translated-label set at :324. Selection dispatch is `dispatchSlashCommandAction` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/slash-command-actions.ts:76-148`), whose only exits are permission modes, six panel openers, `PREFILL_COMMANDS` (:37-39) and `MESSAGE_COMMANDS` (:55-74) — every id in the latter becomes a NORMAL submitted turn. Typed input is parsed by `customSlashCommandInputSubmission` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/custom-slash-command-submission.ts:20-33`), which returns null for an unknown name, so `/btw <question>` falls through `FreeFormInput.submitMessage` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/FreeFormInput.tsx:1376-1440`) and is sent verbatim as a prompt. The one host-side parser that can classify text as a session instruction instead of a prompt knows exactly two kinds, `compact` and `subtask` (`packages/shared/src/slash-commands/session-command.ts:22-58`). The wire has no member for either feature: `SessionCommand` (`packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:491-523`) and its RPC switch (`packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/sessions.ts:540-577`) end at `refreshContextUsage`. Zero hits for `/btw`, `sideQuestion`, `sessionRecap`, `respondToBashCommands`, `emojiCompletionEnabled`, `editorMode`, `vimInsertModeRemaps` across all tracked `.ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.json` (checked with `grep -a` through `git ls-files -z | xargs -0`; the only raw-grep hits are a base64 icon blob in `apps/electron/src/renderer/playground/registry/sample-icons.ts:13` and the untracked build artifact `apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js`). Two substrates the features need DO exist. (1) A tool-less ephemeral query: `BaseAgent.queryLlm` (`packages/shared/src/agent/base-agent.ts:2972`), implemented for Pi as the `llm_query` RPC (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:3850`) whose `queryLlm` builds an ephemeral session with `tools: []` (:2330, :2387-2389) on the mini model, correlated by `pendingLlmQueries` (`packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:812-815`) so it is concurrency-safe with a running turn; Claude at `packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:3140`, Codex at `packages/shared/src/agent/codex-agent.ts:564`, and `NestorCloudAgent.queryLlm` throws (`packages/shared/src/agent/nestor-cloud-agent.ts:190-191`). (2) A transcript summariser: `buildConversationSummaryPrompt`/`generateConversationSummary` (`packages/shared/src/agent/conversation-summary.ts:11-44`), truncating at 500 chars per message and 12 000 chars total (:3-4), used only for remote-transfer handoff (`packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:18766`) and `claude-agent.ts:3129`. `refreshTitle` (`SessionManager.ts:14134`) generates a session TITLE, not a recap, and no timer, idle threshold or window-blur trigger exists. Correcting the filed finding on one point: `!` shell mode IS built — `FreeFormInput.tsx:1399-1416` routes a `!`-prefixed submit to `SessionManager.runShellCommand` (`packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:16372-16495`), which permission-checks it, runs it, and pushes the command+output into the transcript as a user message with a `!` badge (:16440-16479) — i.e. doc :312 and :315 are satisfied. It is narrower than the page in four ways: no automatic model response after the output lands (:321 — our behaviour is a permanent `respondToBashCommands: false`), refused while the session is processing (:16383-16385) and in explore/plan modes (:16393-16402), no `Ctrl+B` backgrounding, and no `Tab` history or file-path autocomplete. Emoji shortcodes have no implementation at all, and `editorMode`/`vimInsertModeRemaps` have no host: the only interactive surface is the Electron composer, and `apps/cli` is non-interactive by design (`apps/cli/src/index.ts:616`, and the sole stdin path `readPrompt` at :423-438 reads piped input with no readline loop).
divergence: Not a key-name or value mismatch — the whole ephemeral out-of-transcript answer channel is missing. `/btw` and `/recap` are absent from the built-in id union, from the typed-input parser, from `parseSessionCommand`, and from the `SessionCommand` wire union, so both strings reach the model as ordinary prose and become permanent transcript turns: the exact opposite of "never enter the conversation history" (:365). The two capabilities `/btw` uniquely needs — no tool access and concurrency with a running turn — already exist in `queryLlm`; what is missing is a session-scoped caller that feeds it the live transcript and returns the answer WITHOUT the three transcript side effects `runShellCommand` performs (`managed.messages.push` / `persistSession`+`flushSession` / `sendEvent({type:'user_message'})`, SessionManager.ts:16462-16479). Secondary, differently-shaped deltas on the same page: `/recap` (on-demand and automatic, with the `/config` -> Session recap toggle) is absent; emoji shortcode completion and `emojiCompletionEnabled` are absent; `respondToBashCommands` has no reader and our shell mode behaves as if it were permanently `false`; `editorMode`/`vimInsertModeRemaps` are absent and have no interactive host to be implemented against.

blastRadius: CROSSES A WIRE BOUNDARY — a repo-declared risk trigger. `SessionCommand` (`packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:491`) is the preload/RPC contract between the renderer (`apps/electron/src/shared/types.ts:401`, ~40 `window.electronAPI.sessionCommand` call sites in `App.tsx` alone) and the server (`packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/sessions.ts`), including the headless/remote-server path, so a renderer newer than its server will hit the `default: never` throw at rpc/sessions.ts:575. Adding a `queryLlm` caller engages the documented backend contract in `packages/shared/AGENTS.md` ("queryLlm backend contract"): four implementations must stay honest — `pi-agent.ts` via `llm_query` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:3850`, envelope invariant guarded by `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/pi-query-llm.test.ts`), `claude-agent.ts:3140`, `codex-agent.ts:564`, and the throwing `nestor-cloud-agent.ts:190`. PERSISTENCE boundary: the answer must never reach `managed.messages`, because anything pushed there is persisted by `persistSession`/`flushSession` and then mirrored by `packages/shared/src/sessions/mirror/host.ts:115` `dispatch` — a side question that lands in the transcript is also a mirrored, exported and rewindable turn, which is the precise thing doc :365 forbids. `SlashCommandId` is consumed by `apps/electron/src/renderer/App.tsx`, `components/app-shell/ChatDisplay.tsx`, `components/app-shell/ActiveOptionBadges.tsx`, `context/AppShellContext.tsx`, `pages/ChatPage.tsx` and `playground/registry/slash-command.tsx` (the playground registry must gain the new states per the repo's playground rule). Tests to extend: `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/__tests__/slash-command-actions.test.ts` (already table-drives every id), `apps/electron/src/renderer/components/ui/__tests__/slash-command-menu.test.tsx`, `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/session-command-seam.test.ts`, `packages/server-core/src/sessions/__tests__/session-command-host-path.test.ts`, `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/conversation-summary.test.ts`. No imported-plugin path is affected: `/btw` and `/recap` are built-ins, not `CustomSlashCommandId`s, so the plugin/skill command discovery in `packages/shared/src/slash-commands/custom-commands.ts` is untouched — but the name-collision rule there means a plugin shipping a `btw.md` command would now be shadowed, worth one line in `selectSkillSlashCommands`' taken-names reasoning.
userImpact: Concrete and immediate. A user who follows Claude's docs and types `/btw what was the name of that config file again?` into the Nessy composer gets no `btw` entry in the `/` menu (nothing matches the filter at slash-command-menu.tsx:271), and on Enter the literal text is sent to the model as a normal prompt: it becomes a permanent user turn in the transcript, is persisted, mirrored and exported, consumes main-context tokens, and interrupts or queues behind the running turn — the four things the command exists to avoid. `/recap` behaves the same way, and additionally the model is being asked to recap while having no idea it was a command. There is also no automatic recap when the user returns to an idle session. Separately observable: typing `:heart:` inserts the literal characters (no emoji), and after `! npm test` the command output lands in the transcript but Claude does not respond to it, so the user must send a second prompt to get the failure explained — Claude Code has responded automatically since v2.1.186. Not observable: `editorMode`/`vimInsertModeRemaps`, which would need a composer-side editor mode to have any surface at all.
notes: Every file and line cited above was read in this session (codegraph verbatim source or direct read). Two corrections to the finding as filed, neither of which rescues it: (a) its claim "there is no `!`-prefixed shell mode" is FALSE — shell mode is built end to end (FreeFormInput.tsx:1399 -> SessionCommand 'runShellCommand' -> SessionManager.runShellCommand:16372) and satisfies doc :312/:315; only `respondToBashCommands`, `Ctrl+B` and `Tab` autocomplete are missing, which is built-partial, not absent. (b) the finding's own evidence grep overstates itself — run verbatim it returns hits from `node_modules` and from the untracked artifact `apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js`; scoped to tracked source the absence claim holds exactly. The `/btw` core (no `/btw`, no `/recap`, no emoji shortcodes) is confirmed absent and is what this spec targets. Two things I could NOT verify from code and that need a decision before implementation: (1) prompt-cache reuse (doc :370) — our `queryLlm` opens a fresh ephemeral session on the MINI model, so a transcript-injected side question does not reuse the parent conversation's cache; matching the doc's cost profile would need the parent session's own context, which the current ephemeral shape cannot give. Injecting the transcript is the pragmatic route and should be recorded as a deviation. (2) `f` fork semantics — `/subtask` forks into a background agent, not the "new session inheriting the parent conversation plus this Q&A, original preserved under /resume" the page specifies (:384); whether our session-fork machinery can produce that shape was not read. `/btw` (this row) and `/recap` share a substrate and should ship together; the emoji/editorMode/`respondToBashCommands` items are a separate, differently-shaped work item (input affordances, not a conversation channel) and should not be folded into the same task.
